description: Maharashtra will pilot the 'Blue Dot AI Economy' platform in Mumbai Suburban and Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar to connect jobseekers with industries using artificial intelligence. Minister Mangal Prabhat Lodha announced agreements with EkStep Foundation and NSDC to strengthen employment and skill development.
body_lead: Mumbai: The Maharashtra government will pilot an artificial intelligence-powered digital platform to connect jobseekers with industries and expand employment opportunities in Mumbai Suburban and Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar districts. Two MoUs Signed For Employment Skill Development, Employment, Entrepreneurship and Innovation Minister Mangal Prabhat Lodha announced the initiative, titled ‘Blue Dot AI Economy’, following the signing of a non-financial memorandum of understanding (MoU) between the state department and EkStep Foundation.
